5.3 The Litho Density Tools
The Litho-Density* Log is an improved and expanded version of the FDC log.  In 
addition to the bulk density measurement, the tool also measures the photoelectric 
absorption index of the formation, Pe.  Photoelectric absorption can be related to 
lithology;  whereas the  ρb measurement responds primarily to porosity and secondarily 
to rock matrix and pore fluid, the Pe measurement responds primarily to rock matrix 
(lithology) and secondarily to porosity and pore fluid.
